interpretation.supported: The retail readback with P2 commit 8541089b is byte-identical to the prior black readback. The new blend setting did not make retail pixels visible in this run, and three-draw refreshes continue to reject the captured target/scissor against PM4_XE_SWAP. The same executable/plugin pair produced the recorded magenta synthetic control with non-black pixels, isolating the retail black output to retail rendering state/path rather than a generally broken readback path.
not_proven: This does not establish that the blend change has no effect in other draw classes or that the renderer change is incorrect.
The run did not show a main menu, visible retail frame, or race.
Single-draw submissions and warning counts are diagnostic observations, not gameplay progress.
